description: This file defines abstract base classes and implementations for kernel template parameter classes used within the PyTorch _inductor module, facilitating serialization, deserialization, and conversion of kernel parameters.

classes.name: KernelTemplateParams
classes.description: Abstract base class for kernel template parameters, defining required methods for conversion to dictionary forms and instantiation from dictionaries.

classes.name: DictKernelTemplateParams
classes.description: Concrete implementation of KernelTemplateParams that wraps a kwargs dictionary, providing methods for serialization and conversion.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] to_kwargs(self)
methods.description: Converts parameters to a dictionary suitable for template.choice_or_none()

methods.name: dict[str,Any] to_serializeable_dict(self)
methods.description: Converts parameters to a serializable dictionary for storage or caching

methods.name: DictKernelTemplateParams from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a KernelTemplateParams instance from a dictionary

methods.name: __init__(self, kwargs: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Initializes DictKernelTemplateParams with a kwargs dictionary

methods.name: to_kwargs
methods.description: Returns a copy of the internal kwargs dictionary

methods.description: Returns a copy of the internal kwargs dictionary for serialization

methods.name: KernelTemplateParams from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any])
